title: Formal Requests and Instructions
goal: Ask for something formally and give a formal instruction.

items: I can ask for something formally with *le ruego que* and *le agradecería que*.
I can give a formal instruction with *sírvase* and *usted* commands.
I can tell a formal request from a blunt one.
